installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'


## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## add below your custom commands if needed

## Specific to Unturned
cd /mnt/server/
ln -sfn ../../../steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so Unturned_Headless_Data/Plugins/x86_64/steamclient.so

## TeamCryptid eggs: the Framework setting (vanilla / ldm / openmod) is applied by the startup
## command, which links the chosen module into Modules/. LDM ships with the game in
## Extras/Rocket.Unturned; OpenMod is downloaded here into .openmod/ (outside Modules/).
echo "Downloading OpenMod module..."
rm -rf /mnt/server/.openmod.new && mkdir -p /mnt/server/.openmod.new
if curl -sfSL -o /tmp/openmod.zip https://github.com/openmod/openmod/releases/latest/download/OpenMod.Unturned.Module.zip \
   && unzip -q -o /tmp/openmod.zip -d /mnt/server/.openmod.new \
   && [ -f /mnt/server/.openmod.new/OpenMod.Unturned/OpenMod.Unturned.module ]; then
    rm -rf /mnt/server/.openmod && mv /mnt/server/.openmod.new /mnt/server/.openmod
    echo "OpenMod module ready"
else
    rm -rf /mnt/server/.openmod.new
    if [ "${FRAMEWORK}" = "openmod" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: OpenMod download failed and Framework is openmod"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "WARNING: OpenMod download failed (only needed for Framework openmod)"
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Login Token (GSLT)
variables.description: Steam Game Server Login Token. Optional, but without one the server is hidden from the internet server list and its Server Code changes every restart. Create one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers with app ID 304930, one per server.

variables.name: Server ID
variables.description: ID of the server for savegames

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam App ID require for install and startup update

variables.name: ld lib path
variables.description: This is needed to load specific libraries

variables.name: Framework
variables.description: vanilla, ldm (Legally Distinct Missile, the RocketMod fork that ships with Unturned) or openmod. Applied on restart. Servers installed before this option existed need one reinstall before openmod works.
